name: explore-diophantine-equations
description: Solve Diophantine equations (integer-only solutions) including linear, quadratic, and Pell equations. Covers the extended Euclidean algorithm, descent methods, and existence proofs. Use when finding all integer solutions to ax + by = c, solving Pell's equation, generating Pythagorean triples, proving no integer solutions exist via modular constraints, or finding the fundamental solution from which all others are generated.
